The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 20fba09b5fed0f63), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 3. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: Let n ≥ 1, let 2 ≤ a1 ≤ · · · ≤ an, and let f1, . . . , fn be a homogeneous regular sequence in C[x1, . . . , xn] with deg fi = ai. There exist a finitely generated field extension k/C, a finite-dimensional central division k-algebra ∆, and a commutative graded k-subalgebra k[x1, . . . , xn] ⊆ A ⊆ ∆[x1, . . . , xn] generated by finitely many pairwise commuting linear forms, with distinguished t1, . . . , tn ∈ A1, such that tai i = cifi + X l<i Bilfl + X d>i Cidtd (1 ≤ i ≤ n). (1.1) Here ci ∈ k×, Bil ∈ Aai−al , and Cid ∈ Aai−1. Moreover, A is finite over k[x], and {tα1 1 · · · tαn n : α ∈ Zn ≥0} is a basis of the full polynomial algebra ∆[x] as a left ∆-vector space.
